description: This file defines search-related commands and functionalities for the CodeMirror code editor, including search overlay, search state management, dialog interactions, and replace operations.

classes.name: SearchState
classes.description: Manages the current state of the search, including query, overlay, and positions.

methods.name: searchOverlay
methods.description: Creates an overlay for search highlighting based on the query.

methods.name: getSearchState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the search state for a CodeMirror instance.

methods.name: startSearch
methods.description: Begins a search with the specified query and updates the overlay.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Performs the search operation, handling dialog interactions and navigation.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the current search overlay and state.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs replace operations, either single or all matches.
